title: Influence of odd-dimensional majority
statement: For every nonnegative integer $m$ and every coordinate $i$ of the $(2m+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube, the influence of coordinate $i$ for majority on that cube is $$\\frac{\\binom{2m}{m}}{2^{2m}}.$$
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate of the $(2m+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube
